dict.string: NotChi uses the local network to send and receive files with Android phones via Quick Share.
NotChi saves files received from your phone to Downloads and shows new AirDrop arrivals in the notch.
NotChi shows today's events in the notch and finds Zoom, Meet, Teams and Webex links so you can join with one click. Events never leave your Mac.
